purpose: Evaluation-only, human-reviewed approximate Alcohol-statement geometry for the six frozen LOW_CONFIDENCE cases. Not used as OCR input, not used for ranking. Existing this-repository provenance style (annotatedBy/annotatedOn/method) applied per case.
annotationMethod: Two-pass visual estimation against the exact, code-derived crop-rectangle overlay (crop-geometry.json), performed in a single review session (not an independent second reader). Pass 1: locate the alcohol statement and estimate a normalized bounding box. Pass 2: re-check the box against the drawn left/right crop-boundary lines (whose pixel positions are known exactly, not estimated) and confirm or revise. Flagged as single-session self-annotation, not independent two-reader adjudication.
